subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up + clarifying Qs)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: security@acmehealth.com <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up + clarifying Qs)

Hi Liam / Acme security team,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — good to meet you. As discussed, we're initiating the SIG security questionnaire so your team can validate our controls and accelerate procurement. I've attached the latest SIG spreadsheet (SIG_v1.xlsx) and a short SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf) to kick things off.

Couple of quick clarifying questions to help us prioritize responses: 
- Can you confirm which questionnaire sections you want completed first (e.g., Security, Data Protection, Availability)?
- Do you consider AcmeHealth data to include PHI under your scoping (HIPAA)? If yes, which environments would PHI touch (hosted API only, dedicated, or private)?
- Is a full SOC 2 Type II report required for review, or will the SOC 2 summary and SOC 2 bridge letter suffice for your checklist initially?
- Preferred delivery for completed attachments: secure SFTP, shared Drive link, or your vendor portal?
- Target timeline for the completed SIG from Acme side (we typically shoot for 7–10 business days if no blockers).

We'll start filling the Security and Data Protection tabs first and flag any items that need policy excerpts or evidence. Looping in Marissa (security) and Jonas (solutions) who will own the questionnaire responses.

Next steps: we'll upload completed sections to the Drive link below and share per your delivery preference.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
redwood.com

Attachments (2): SIG_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (1-page summary)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 12:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up + clarifying Qs)

Hi Camila — thanks for sending this over and for the call. Quick answers below: 
- Please prioritize Security and Data Protection sections first, followed by Availability.
- Yes, AcmeHealth will be scoping PHI for this engagement (HIPAA applies). PHI will be stored for some customers in our hosted environment; we are evaluating Dedicated for higher-volume flows.
- For initial review, a SOC 2 Type II report is preferred, but a SOC 2 summary + bridge letter is acceptable to start while we collect the full report. Ultimately procurement will want the Type II before final PO.
- Preferred delivery: secure vendor portal (we will send an invite). If not available, SFTP is fine.
- Target timeline: we'd like completed SIG sections within 10 business days; procurement will follow up on SOC documents in parallel.

Couple of clarifying Qs for Redwood: 
1) For HIPAA scoping, can you confirm which environments and whether logs/analytics might contain PHI?
2) Do you provide a BAA for Private and Dedicated deployments, and is the same BAA template available for Hosted with datacenter restrictions?

I'll wait for the vendor portal invite and the first pass on Security/Data Protection.

Best,
Liam
Security Operations Manager
AcmeHealth

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up + clarifying Qs)

Marissa / Jonas — forwarding Acme's initial reply. Highlights: they are scoping PHI (HIPAA), want Security + Data Protection first, prefer vendor portal or SFTP, and want SOC 2 Type II eventually (summary ok for now). They asked two clarifying Qs: 
1) Confirm environments/logging that may contain PHI
2) BAA availability and templates for Hosted/Dedicated/Private

Can you take point on answers? Jonas, can you prepare a first-pass for the Security + Data Protection tabs (I'll share the SIG_v1.xlsx) — Marissa, can you draft the BAA guidance and confirm whether logs/analytics contain PHI and what we can redact/share?

Target: have our completed Security/Data Protection tabs and BAA guidance back to Acme within 7 business days. If anything looks like it will slip, flag early and we'll negotiate timeline with Liam.

Thanks — Camila

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up + clarifying Qs)

Thanks Camila — noted. Quick answers and plan: 
- Environments: PHI may be present in requests routed to Hosted API depending on customer config; Dedicated and Private deployments can be scoped out of PHI if customer requires. We'll confirm exact endpoints/log retention for Acme during the questionnaire.
- Logs/analytics: request/response logs may include PHI unless customers opt into redaction. We can provide sampling and redacted examples as evidence.
- BAA: we have a standard BAA that covers Dedicated and Private by default; for Hosted we have a Hosted BAA addendum that includes data residency and contractual safeguards. I'll attach the BAA template and the Hosted addendum to the Drive folder.
- SOC 2: full Type II will be provided to procurement under NDA or secure portal; we'll include the SOC 2 summary in the first upload.

Plan: Jonas will finish the Security/Data Protection tabs and mark items needing artifacts. I'll assemble the BAA templates and redaction examples. We'll target to upload to Acme's vendor portal (or SFTP) within 5 business days from today.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-soc2

-M
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
